bibl.title: Homer restored: Virtual reconstruction of Papyrus Bodmer 1.
bibl.seg: Simon Perrin, Léopold Cudilla, Yejing Xie, Harold Mouchère & Isabelle Marthot-Santaniello, Homer restored: Virtual reconstruction of Papyrus Bodmer 1.

Apostolos Antonacopoulos, Christian Clausner, Maud Ehrmann, Kai Labusch, Clemens Neudecker & Randy Wilson (edd.), Proceedings of the 7th International Workshop on Historical Document Imaging and Processing (HIP '23), August 25-26, 2023, San Jose, CA, USA (New York, 2023) pp. 37-42, figg.
bibl.note: Proposes a complete method to reconstruct a damaged piece of P. Bodmer I (= MP3 736; LDAB 7335), bearing Iliad 5.645-678. - 1. Introduction. - 2. Related works. - 3. Proposed method: 3.1. Text reconstruction; - 3.2. Background reconstruction. - 4. Experiments: 4.1. Dataset; - 4.2. Implementation details. - 5. Results and discussion: 5.1. Subjective visual analysis; - 5.2. Analysis by papyrology experts. - 6. Conclusion and future work.
